description: The line plot illustrates the Area Under the Curve (AUC, in percent) as a function of the parameter N, which ranges from 0 to 20 on the linear x-axis. The y-axis, labeled “AUC (%)”, spans from 75% to 100% in increments of 5%. Five distinct lines, each with a unique color, marker, and line style, represent different configurations or methods. The blue line with circle markers starts at approximately 94% when N=0, rises to 98.5% at N=5, peaks at 99% at N=10, and then declines to 94% at N=20. The orange line with diamond markers begins at 84% at N=0, increases to 92.5% at N=5, reaches 95% at N=10, and remains relatively flat around 94.5% at N=20. The red line with square markers starts at 87% at N=0, climbs steadily to 99% at N=10, then drops to 91% at N=20. The green line with star markers begins at 86.5% at N=0, rises to 90.5% at N=5, reaches 92.5% at N=10, and ends at 92% at N=20. The purple line with triangle markers starts at 79.5% at N=0, dips slightly to 79% at N=5, spikes to 96.5% at N=10, then falls to 85.5% at N=15 and further to 82.5% at N=20. All lines exhibit non-monotonic behavior, with most peaking around N=10 before declining or stabilizing.
